title: reg_transform
description: Tool for performing various transformation operations on medical images including control point to deformation conversion, composition of transformations, and converting between deformation and displacement fields.

cpp2def_input.description: Conversion from control point position to deformation field. Filename of input lattice of control point positions (CPP).
cpp2def_input.title: CPP to DEF Input

cpp2def_output.description: Filename of the output deformation field image (DEF).
cpp2def_output.title: CPP to DEF Output

comp1_cpp2.description: Composition of two lattices of control points. CPP2(CPP1(x)). Filename of lattice of control point that contains the second deformation (CPP2).
comp1_cpp2.title: Second CPP for Composition 1

comp1_cpp1.description: Filename of lattice of control point that contains the initial deformation (CPP1).
comp1_cpp1.title: First CPP for Composition 1

comp1_output.description: Filename of the output deformation field.
comp1_output.title: Output for Composition 1

comp2_cpp.description: Composition of a deformation field with a lattice of control points. CPP(DEF(x)). Filename of lattice of control point that contains the second deformation (CPP).
comp2_cpp.title: CPP for Composition 2

comp2_def.description: Filename of the deformation field to be used as initial deformation (DEF).
comp2_def.title: DEF for Composition 2

comp2_output.description: Filename of the output deformation field.
comp2_output.title: Output for Composition 2

comp3_def2.description: Composition of two deformation fields. DEF2(DEF1(x)). Filename of the second deformation field (DEF2).
comp3_def2.title: Second DEF for Composition 3

comp3_def1.description: Filename of the first deformation field (DEF1).
comp3_def1.title: First DEF for Composition 3

comp3_output.description: Filename of the output deformation field.
comp3_output.title: Output for Composition 3

def2disp_input.description: Convert a deformation field into a displacement field. Filename of deformation field x'=T(x).
def2disp_input.title: DEF to DISP Input

disp2def_input.description: Convert a displacement field into a deformation field. Filename of displacement field x'=x+T(x).
disp2def_input.title: DISP to DEF Input

upd_sform_image.description: Update the sform of a floating (source) image using an affine transformation. Filename of image to be updated.
upd_sform_image.title: Update Sform Image

upd_sform_affine.description: Affine transformation defined as Affine x Reference = Floating. Filename of affine transformation.
upd_sform_affine.title: Update Sform Affine

aff2def_affine.description: Compose a non-rigid with an affine. Filename of affine transformation.
aff2def_affine.title: Affine for Aff2Def

aff2def_target.description: Image used as a target for the non-rigid step.
aff2def_target.title: Target for Aff2Def

aff2def_cpp_or_def.description: Reference image (B). Filename of control point position or deformation field.
aff2def_cpp_or_def.title: CPP or DEF for Aff2Def

inv_affine_input.description: Invert an affine transformation matrix. Filename of input affine matrix.
inv_affine_input.title: Input Affine for Inversion

comp_aff_1st.description: Compose two affine transformation matrices. Filename of first affine matrix.
comp_aff_1st.title: First Affine for Composition

comp_aff_output.description: Filename of composed affine matrix result.
comp_aff_output.title: Output Affine for Composition
